top_signals.title: Stocks Fall on Nvidia Rout With Anthropic in Focus: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Wall Street saw renewed volatility as Nvidia Corp.’s post-earnings rally fizzled out, a sign that investors are looking for more evidence about the durability of the artificial-intelligence trade.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
